english: Because the weather was very hot, he carried the bed on to the roof of his house.
text: Because the weather was very hot 放在句首，是先把抬床的原因摆明，再讲后面的动作。如果原因是已知信息，也可以说 He carried the bed on to the roof because it was very hot，重点就落在动作上。
